page.content:
Title immigrant, Treasury secretary, and Miranda's original role.

How Alexander Hamilton connects

  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — Alexander Hamilton is the title figure of the musical.
  • Artist: Lin-Manuel Miranda — Miranda originated Alexander Hamilton on stage.
  • Character: Aaron Burr — Burr's rivalry with Hamilton ends in the Weehawken duel.
  • Character: Eliza Schuyler Hamilton — Eliza marries Hamilton and outlives him to tell the story.
  • Character: George Washington — Washington makes Hamilton his aide and later his Treasury secretary.
  • Character: Angelica Schuyler Church — Angelica trades verses with Hamilton and cedes him to Eliza.
  • Work: Cabinet Battle — Hamilton argues assumption and neutrality in the Cabinet Battles.
  • Work: My Shot — Hamilton leads My Shot with Laurens, Lafayette, and Mulligan.
  • Character: Philip Hamilton — Philip dies in a duel defending his father's name.
  • Character: John Laurens — Laurens is Hamilton's closest friend in the war quartet.

What is Alexander Hamilton?

Alexander Hamilton is the orphan from Nevis who writes his way into Washington's war, the Federalist Papers, and the first Cabinet, then dies in the duel with Aaron Burr that the musical treats as its ending.

Key threads lead to Hamilton (musical), Lin-Manuel Miranda, Aaron Burr, Eliza Schuyler Hamilton, George Washington and Angelica Schuyler Church.
